notes.hook: The massive scale of 16 million light-years is an effective immediately stopping point.
notes.clarity: The comparison to one hundred Milky Ways provides a clear mental model for scale.
notes.payoff: The irony of a record-breaking structure having a normal heart is a good subversion.
notes.visuals: Several frames rely too heavily on text-dense charts and diagrams rather than immersive space imagery.
notes.loop: The transition from the 'ordinary heart' back to the 'colossal galaxy' works well.

rounds.better_than_last: This short utilizes more effective scale comparisons than ep346 by using the Milky Way as a benchmark.
